title: IPMA, weather warnings open data (warnings_www.json)
what_it_says: IPMA's open data for weather warnings by area; area LSB is the Lisbon district. Read at 16:32 UTC on 10 November 2026, after the article's 14:23 and 14:34 readings: the Lisbon warnings were unchanged. Read again at 18:32 UTC: the rain warning for Wednesday had become red from 12:00 to 18:00 (orange before that). Read a third time at 20:37 UTC: Wednesday's warnings unchanged since 18:32. Read a fourth time at 22:32 UTC (unchanged) and a fifth at 00:32 UTC on 11 November: the red rain warning had moved earlier, to 09:00 to 18:00. Read a sixth time at 02:34 UTC: unchanged since 00:32. Web Summit's Day 2 statement and homepage notice were also unchanged at 02:34. Read a seventh time at 04:32 UTC: unchanged since 00:32 (Web Summit's statement and homepage notice also unchanged). Read an eighth time at 06:32 UTC: unchanged (Web Summit's statement and homepage notice also unchanged). Read a ninth time at 08:32 UTC: unchanged for Wednesday; Tuesday night's yellow sea warning (to 06:00) had expired and left the file. Read a tenth time at 10:32 UTC: the wind warning had been lowered from red to orange. Read an eleventh time at 12:32 UTC: Wednesday's warnings unchanged in level and time (rain red 09:00 to 18:00, wind orange 09:00 to 21:00, sea orange 12:00 to 21:00).
